mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS shows a 3-month average increase of > 200k, indicating a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, signaling supply chain resilience, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating increased retail sales, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered holiday season instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (inflation-adjusted) predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days; when the spread is > 2%, returns are positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances with spread > 2%, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.035 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the level of UNRATE, as a standalone indicator of labor market health, inversely correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant inverse relationship with UNRATE levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a > 5% quarterly increase in GDPC1 and a > 10% year-over-year increase in HOUST predicts a surge in consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.
